adminAgents.title: Agents

adminAgents.watch.lede: Every bank has these. They read public sources and feed the shared library.

adminAgents.stop.body: {name} stops now. What it found so far is kept, and the run shows as stopped with what it cost.
adminAgents.stop.done: Stopped. The run shows as stopped under Recent runs.

adminAgents.add.title: Add an agent
adminAgents.add.note: It starts switched off, so nothing runs until you switch it on.

adminAgents.refusal.abovePlanLimit: Our plan does not allow this, so nothing changed.
